item.title: Wildcats, Rainforests and Rare Plants Benefit From £5.2 Million Nature Fund
item.description: Nature projects across Scotland are sharing a £5.2 million funding boost, supporting rainforest restoration, wildcat recovery, and threatened plant species as part of national efforts to tackle biodiversity loss and climate change.The post Wildcats, Rainforests and Rare Plants Benefit From £5.2 Million Nature Fund appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Michelin Recognition Puts The Three Chimneys at Talisker on The Global Map
item.description: Michelin recognition for The Three Chimneys at Talisker marks a defining moment for Skye’s food scene, celebrating locally sourced dining beside Talisker Distillery and reinforcing the island’s growing reputation as a world class culinary destination.The post Michelin Recognition Puts The Three Chimneys at Talisker on The Global Map appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Japanese Crew Hit By Setback as Monte Carlo Historique Begins in John O’Groats
item.description: A Japanese crew heading for the Monte Carlo Historique Rally has been dealt a major blow after their cherished family car was delayed at sea, as this year’s centenary event prepares to start from John O’Groats.The post Japanese Crew Hit By Setback as Monte Carlo Historique Begins in John O’Groats appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Communities Across Scotland Invited to Grow Together Through Climate and Nature Network
item.description: Community groups across Scotland are being invited to join Keep Scotland Beautiful’s Climate and Nature Friendly Communities Network, offering free support, mentoring and national recognition to local gardening projects working to protect nature and strengthen communities.The post Communities Across Scotland Invited to Grow Together Through Climate and Nature Network appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Demands Answers After Labour Bid to Appoint Cammy Day to NHS Board Blocked
item.description: The SNP is demanding transparency after a Labour backed attempt to appoint former Edinburgh Council leader Cammy Day to a paid NHS Lothian board role was blocked, raising questions about ethics, accountability and political influence.The post SNP Demands Answers After Labour Bid to Appoint Cammy Day to NHS Board Blocked appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Student’s Small Yes That Helped Feed Children Across The World
item.description: A university student from Scotland shares how volunteering with Mary’s Meals transformed her life, showing how even small acts of service can help feed children, restore purpose and quietly change the world, one meal at a time.The post A Student’s Small Yes That Helped Feed Children Across The World appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Questions Hang Over Sarwar as SNP Press Labour Leader Ahead of FMQs
item.description: The SNP is pressing Scottish Labour leader Anas Sarwar for answers ahead of First Minister’s Questions over why Pam Duncan-Glancy MSP remains in the party, raising questions of judgement, accountability and standards within Labour’s leadership.The post Questions Hang Over Sarwar as SNP Press Labour Leader Ahead of FMQs appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Rising Vet Bills Forcing Pet Owners to Delay Care, New Research Finds
item.description: New UK research reveals rising vet bills are forcing many pet owners to delay or skip treatment, with growing support for transparent pricing and national vet fees as households struggle to balance animal care with rising living costs.The post Rising Vet Bills Forcing Pet Owners to Delay Care, New Research Finds appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Monte Carlo Rally Returns to John O’Groats as Classic Cars Head South on Centenary Run
item.description: Classic and historic cars have set off from John O’Groats on a 1500 mile journey to Monaco as the Monte Carlo Classique and Historique Rally returns to its traditional northern start to mark the event’s centenary year.The post Monte Carlo Rally Returns to John O’Groats as Classic Cars Head South on Centenary Run appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Fewer Families in Temporary Accommodation as Highland Housing Pressures Ease
item.description: The number of households in temporary accommodation across the Highlands has fallen to its lowest level since 2016, as new figures show improvements in homelessness outcomes, faster repairs and the lowest rent arrears recorded in three years.The post Fewer Families in Temporary Accommodation as Highland Housing Pressures Ease appeared first on The Highland Times.
